capabilities: Generate a vault map canvas with one command
Control which folders appear using map-as note or hide properties
Choose the folder note convention (same-name, index file, or adjacent file)
Customize card content, size, colors, and output location
Re-drag, rename, and edit cards by hand without touching vault files
disambiguation: Not a live graph view; it produces a one-time snapshot canvas that does not update when the vault changes.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; maps are timestamped snapshots saved as new canvases rather than updating an existing file.
problem: Obsidian has no way to see the whole vault's folder structure at once on a canvas to plan reorganization, merging or removal.
summary: Generates a static canvas map of the vault where folders with folder notes become groups containing their notes as cards.
